items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: Sizzling the blues was Joke of Pryor's.

ctx.x: What tune was that you used the dong on?

I think it was on Ideas. I think that, because that was Sydney's tune. Ideas was Sydney's and, uh, get with it was Sydney's. Sizzling the blues was Joke of Pryor's. And I tried to steal High Society, but they caught me.
I think that's public domain anyway, really.
